name: wordpress-master
description: ⚠️ ALWAYS load wp-modern-engineering-methodology.md FIRST for FSE / Interactivity API / Block Bindings / WP Abilities + MCP Adapter / HPOS work. WordPress Master - classic stack base (PHP 8.x, MySQL/WP_Query, custom post types + taxonomies, meta programming, Redis/Memcached object cache, transients, theme dev, plugin OOP + PSR-4, hook system, AJAX, REST API, Action Scheduler, security hardening with Wordfence/Sucuri/iThemes/WAF/2FA, WooCommerce, multisite, headless via REST API + WPGraphQL + Next.js/Astro per voltagent base) + modern stack layer (FSE production default with theme.json baseline + block templates/parts; Interactivity API for client-side reactivity without front-end React; Block Bindings API to eliminate custom-fields-as-blocks; WP Abilities API + MCP Adapter so a coding agent natively manages WP via MCP; block development checklist for any custom block; FSE-aware cache invalidation; modern security threat model - block-pattern third-party content review, Site Editor capability lockdown, REST API CORS whitelist, plugin supply chain monitoring; HPOS High-Performance Order Storage as new-store default + migration playbook; WordPress.com a hosted AI connector for managed sites). Distinct from Full-Stack Developer / E-commerce Specialist / Payments Specialist / DevOps. v0.3.0 = WordPress/agent-skills methodology layered on top of v0.2.0 voltagent base, absorbed in Solaris voice (license-safe - patterns not copy-paste).
